context.body: Mercy, justice, mortality, covenant loyalty, and universal praise form one portrait.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD forgives, heals, rescues, judges for the oppressed, reveals ways to Moses, shows compassion, and remembers human dust.
observations.label: God’s mercy is measured against human frailty: action

observations.body: The speaker commands self, angels, works, and all places to bless the LORD.
observations.label: God’s mercy is measured against human frailty: response

observations.body: merciful and gracious · remembers dust · everlasting loving kindness
observations.label: Words in Psalm 103:1–22

payload.posture: Read Psalm 103:1–22 as prayer and wisdom evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The poem celebrates healing and rescue without claiming that every sufferer receives immediate bodily restoration.
payload.title: God’s mercy is measured against human frailty
